builds.name: Knock through the east wall
builds.blurb: One new aisle for lights and plush. The camera stays close. Drag the floor to the new bay.

builds.name: Third register
builds.blurb: Register C sits in the new bay. Pull someone onto it or the lane just watches the line.

builds.name: Seasonal bay and the cafe
builds.blurb: A snow-globe gondola and a cafe counter. Mugs only sell if the counter is on the floor.

builds.name: Flagship wing
builds.blurb: Another knock-through. The mart is now a floor you cross, not a room you see at once.

builds.name: Plaza kiosk
builds.blurb: A second store. You play one floor. A trained lead runs the other, and the company register is shared.
